claim: Pages and sites count every row that has not been deleted, drafts included; active sites are the ones switched on; active domains are switched-on domains attached to an active site
The count runs every hour from the server's Laravel scheduler, which must be running
The last count of each day is the one kept, because a later run on the same day replaces that day's totals
Only the current day can be counted, so a day without a run stays blank and cannot be filled in afterwards
The health check flags no count before the first run and again once 24 hours pass without a completed count
The totals appear as one card each on the Site metrics page with the latest figure and a 30-day line, as the screenshot shows
Counts come only from pages, sites and domains in the database, with no visitor data and no outside service
Only global administrators can see the figures
